summary: One-frame event of esv::inventory::StackSystem, born whenever a stack's amount changes (potions, containers, thrown dagger picked up, scripted events in act 1). Registered with size 4 and no destructor (bg3.exe+0x34B30D0). Queried together with MemberAdded/MemberRemoved events by esv::camp::SupplySystem.

fields.name: AmountChange
fields.evidence: Only member (adder bg3.exe+0x34B30D0 allocates 4 bytes with ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw and stores 0). Its only caller bg3.exe+0x34AD110 (part of esv::inventory::StackSystem) sums the amounts (+4 of each 8-byte stack element) of the stack after the change (uVar12) and before it (iVar14) and, when they differ, adds the event with *value = new - old: a signed difference of the stack's total amount. Live values 1..0x111 are increases.

second_pass: The writer bg3.exe+0x34AD110 (StackSystem stack merge) shows the one 4-byte member is the signed change of the stack's total amount (new sum minus old sum), stored only when non-zero; size and width from the adder bg3.exe+0x34B30D0.
